tools.name: create_doc
tools.description:
Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text
        are stored unchanged. Returns ok=true and the stored document, including
        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

tools.name: get_feature_flag
tools.description:
Get one feature flag by its exact key from list_feature_flags.

        IDs, display names, and partial matches are not accepted. Returns the
        complete stored flag so its current status and rollout are checkable.

tools.name: query_experiment_results
tools.description: Get one saved result by exact experiment_id from list_experiments.

tools.name: list_feature_flags
tools.description:
List feature flags and their exact keys.

        status may be draft, running, shipped, rolled_back, or decommissioned.
        owner must exactly match a stored owner key. Omit a filter to search
        across every value for that field.

tools.name: list_experiments
tools.description: List experiments and their exact experiment_id values, optionally by status.

tools.name: memanto_recall
tools.description: Search the Memanto memory agent by semantic similarity. Use this FIRST before asking the user to repeat information.

arguments.body:
## Stored result and state

- **Current stored numeric result:** `starter_growth_conversion` was 12.0% control vs. 10.3% treatment, a **−1.7 percentage-point** difference (p=0.04; n=20,000; 10,000 per arm).
- **Current allocation:** `pricing_page_2023q2_rev` is at **0%**; the flag is **decommissioned**.
- **Documented confound:** A signup-form layout change went live March 2 during the experiment window, so the observed result cannot cleanly isolate the pricing-page change.
- **Rollback state:** The experiment is rolled back; the flag record’s notes say its status remains rolled back. Decommissioned is the flag’s current registry status, not an active allocation.

The stored −1.7-point result is reported as recorded, not as a clean causal estimate. Earlier numeric reads are not substituted for this current stored result. No production changes were made.
